item.title: Inside Rose Byrne's leading lady moment

For too long, Rose Byrne's virtuosic work in comedy classics like Bridesmaids and Spy went unsung, but a powerhouse performance in If I Had Legs I'd Kick You has launched her into the spotlight she has so long deserved. She unpacks a whirlwind awards season with James Reginato.

item.title: Why Rose Byrne is long overdue an Oscar
item.description: Rose Byrne has been a quiet critical darling since she first hit the screen at the age of 15. This year, a star turn in If I Had Legs I'd Kick You has finally seen her get her flowers – and an Oscar nomination – but the Academy should have been paying attention long ago…
